bollingerBands._comment: Bollinger Bands indicator configuration (Session 105+ calibration: now configurable)

BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._comment: Calibration parameters (Session 105+): All BB thresholds now configurable
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._minCandlesForBollingerBands_comment: Minimum candles needed for BB calculation (default: 25, range: 20-100)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._neutralLower_comment: Lower bound of neutral zone (default: 40, range: 30-50)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._neutralUpper_comment: Upper bound of neutral zone (default: 60, range: 50-70)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._squeezeThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for squeeze detection (default: 5%, range: 3-10)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._expansionThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for expansion detection (default: 10%, range: 8-15)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._neutralConfidenceMultiplier_comment: Confidence multiplier for neutral zone (default: 0.2 = 20%, range: 0.1-0.3)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._moderateConfidenceMultiplier_comment: Confidence multiplier for moderate zone (default: 0.4 = 40%, range: 0.3-0.6)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._volatilityVeryLowThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for very low volatility (default: 3%, range: 1-5)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._volatilityLowThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for low volatility (default: 6%, range: 4-8)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._volatilityNormalThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for normal volatility (default: 10%, range: 8-12)
BOLLINGER_BANDS_ANALYZER_NEW._volatilityHighThreshold_comment: Bandwidth threshold for high volatility (default: 15%, range: 12-20)

notes: DEBUG: Single Bollinger Bands analyzer with calibrated thresholds. All filters disabled for pure BB signal testing.
